narr: Strong thunderstorm developed in southeast Mississippi and produced locally heavy rain along with strong wind gusts that caused some damage.
ev: Heavy rain caused pumping station road to be closed due to culverts washing out.
lsr: EMA REPORTS THAT PUMPING STATION RD IS CLOSED DUE TO CULVERTS WASHING OUT IN THE HEAVY RAIN. NEARBY RIVER GAUGE AT THE TALLAHALA CREEK NEAR RUNNELSTOWN SHOWED A QUICK RISE OF NEARLY 9 FEET THROUGHOUT
